title: Some concerns
text: Some concerns. Had to take it in for repairs within 3 months of purchase.  Luckily it has a 3 year warranty.  Aside from concerns about durability, it does suck- I mean it is effective at what it is supposed to do.

product_metadata.title: Eureka SuctionSeal Pet Bagless Upright Vacuum, AS1104A
description: Product Description

The Eureka SuctionSeal bagless upright has concentrated suction for maximum cleaning on carpets and barefloors. Wide tubes that increase the amount of airflow for superior suction & cleaning. This unit picks up pet hair and liter from carpets and bare floors. This model maintains suction power as you vacuum your home.
Amazon.com
Deep Cleaning Power on All Floors.

Proven to Clean Carpets Better Than Dyson DC25 and DC41 For Less Than ½ The Price,* the SuctionSeal™ PET bagless upright combines Eureka exclusive AirSpeed® Technology with SuctionSeal™ Technology for deep cleaning power on all floor surfaces.
SuctionSeal Technology

All-Surface Suction Plates concentrates airflow for deep cleaning suction power. As you move across carpet, hardwood or tile floors the plates raise and lower, creating a seal to maximize airflow for powerful cleaning performance. Whether it’s surface dirt or debris hiding in crevices, it’s sucked up and away without any scattering.
AirSpeed Technology

Unlike other vacuums, AirSpeed® Technology has two smooth tubes, featuring limited bends and turns. This allows more air to pass through the vacuum. The direct air path from floor to cup, decreases the distance for dirt to travel, which increases the amount of airflow for powerful suction.
Never Loses Suction

Eureka has engineered SuctionSeal™ to provide maximum suction power longer than other types of vacuums.* Tested to strict industry standards, Eureka’s multi-cyclonic dust cup system never loses suction and maintains power as you vacuum your home.^
Tough Enough for Pet Owners

Designed to deep clean pet hair from carpets, bare floors, upholstery and more. The SuctionSeal™ Pet features a Pet Upholstery Brush, a turbo driven PET Power Paw®, and a 39 foot hose and wand to clean above the floors. The on/off brushroll switch lets you clean carpets and bare floors. This model includes an odor absorbing HEPA filter to eliminate pet odors and reduce allergens for a cleaner home. *Based on a comparison between (a) regular MSRP of Eureka SuctionSeal™ PET and Dyson DC25 and DC41 vacuums as of November 2011 (b) independent lab tests using industry standard ASTM F608 test, measuring embedded dirt removal from carpeting. *When compared to conventional bagged and single stage cyclonic vacuums having dirt cup filters. ^Eureka proves no loss of suction through IEC Test 60312-1 First Edition, Clause 5.9. Test results within variability tolerance of 5%
Additional Product Features
All Surface Cleaning
Designed to deep clean carpets, bare floors, upholstery and more.
Automatic Cord Rewind
Rewinds cord effortlessly for quick and easy storage.
PET Power Paw® Turbo Brush
Removes pet hair from carpet and upholstery. Plastic teeth loosen it, a rubber strip grabs it and bristles remove it.
Flip-Bottom Dust Cup
Allows you to empty the dust cup quickly and easily without touching the captured dust. Emptying the dust cup regularly, as needed, will help to maintain optimum cleaning performance.
Washable Dust Cup Filter
Save money and lessen waste by washing and reusing the allergy-reducing filter.
Low Profile Cleaning Nozzle
Reaches under furniture and close to baseboards.
Foot Controlled, 7-Setting Height Adjustment
Easily adjust to clean most floor surfaces.
EZ Roll® Soft Wheels
Wheels won’t scratch or nick hard floors.
